title: It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Murder
description: After inheriting an old house from her beloved aunt, Diana Hart finds clues that suggest her aunt was murdered and the culprit might be her handsome companion.

title: Match, Meet, Murder
description: Diving into the world of dating apps, a lingerie designer meets a handsome stranger who's smart, successful, and a former contestant on a dating show. However, she soon learns that the show wasn't the only secret he failed to mention in his profile.

title: Cellmate Secrets
description:
S01 E06 — Shayna Hubers
Shayna Hubers shot and killed her boyfriend, Ryan Poston; now Holly Nivens details how Shayna manipulated her into believing it was self-defense; Cecily Miller details Shayna's behavior after her arrest; Carissa details how Ryan wanted out.

description:
S01 E05 — Susan Smith
